security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown code fences, fixed memory paths, metadata URLs, and documentation links. The confirmed risk is the optional connector workflow, which asks agents to run local scripts and perform outbound competitor scraping.

remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user approval before running connector scripts, and document the exact command, arguments, and outbound destinations.

remediation.issue: Outbound scraping and third-party data transfer
remediation.suggestion: Provide a no-network fallback and clearly state what domains, URLs, and topics may be sent to Firecrawl or trend sources.
Replace parent-directory links with marketplace-safe references or bundle required documentation inside the skill package.

content.value_statement: Teams miss topics when competitor coverage, keywords, and funnel needs are reviewed separately. This skill turns those signals into prioritized gaps and a content calendar.
actual_capabilities: Compares your site with competitors across keywords, topics, formats, funnel stages, and GEO opportunities.
Groups opportunities into Quick Wins, Strategic Builds, and Long-term priorities.
Labels metrics as Measured, User-provided, Estimated, or N/A to avoid unsupported claims.
Builds dated content calendar entries for approved Quick Win gaps.
Uses templates for keyword gaps, SERP formats, funnel coverage, and opportunity scoring.
limitations: It does not replace raw keyword demand discovery; use keyword-research for that task.
It needs your current coverage and at least one competitor to define real gaps.
Metrics may be estimated when SEO, analytics, or search console data is unavailable.
Optional connector workflows need environment support and should require user approval.

use_cases.title: Prioritize Quarterly SEO Gaps
use_cases.description: Compare your domain with key competitors and identify the highest-value missing topics for the next planning cycle.

use_cases.title: Build An Editorial Calendar
use_cases.description: Turn verified content gaps into dated Quick Wins, Strategic Builds, and Long-term content opportunities.

use_cases.title: Improve GEO Coverage
use_cases.description: Find missing Q&A, definition, and comparison content that can improve visibility in AI-generated answers.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Two Domains
prompt_templates.prompt: Find content gaps between my site [site] and [competitor]. Focus on [topic] and label every metric source.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Next Month
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze our content inventory and competitor list. Return Quick Wins, Strategic Builds, Long-term gaps, and dated calendar items for Quick Wins.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Funnel Coverage
prompt_templates.prompt: Map our funnel content against [competitors]. Find gaps by Awareness, Consideration, Decision, and Retention stage.

prompt_templates.title: Review Competitive Clusters
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare our topic cluster coverage for [topic] against five competitors. Include keyword, format, GEO, and opportunity scoring evidence.

output_examples.input: Find gaps between our B2B analytics site and three competitors.
output_examples.output: A ranked brief lists Quick Wins, Strategic Builds, and Long-term gaps, with competitor proof and calendar recommendations.

output_examples.input: Check if our pricing and comparison content is weaker than competitors.
output_examples.output: The result maps funnel-stage gaps, missing formats, likely business impact, and suggested comparison pages.

output_examples.input: Show topic cluster gaps for customer data platforms.
output_examples.output: The skill summarizes missing pillars, cluster pages, GEO questions, and estimated opportunity scores.

best_practices: Provide your domain, one to three competitors, topic scope, and business goal.
Share exports or URLs for existing content when analytics or SEO tools are unavailable.
Ask for source labels so estimates stay separate from measured data.
anti_patterns: Asking for generic keyword ideas without a competitor or current content inventory.
Treating estimated volume or traffic as measured proof.
Publishing every competitor topic without checking relevance and creation effort.

faq.question: Does this skill need paid SEO tools?
faq.answer: No. Paid tools improve evidence quality, but the skill can work with URLs, exports, and clearly labeled estimates.

faq.question: How many competitors should I provide?
faq.answer: One to three close competitors is enough for most requests. Broader reviews can use up to five competitors.

faq.question: Can it write the finished articles?
faq.answer: No. It plans gaps and handoff details. Use a content-writing skill after you approve priorities.

faq.question: How does it handle missing data?
faq.answer: It marks unavailable metrics as N/A or Estimated. It should not present model guesses as measured facts.

faq.question: Does it support GEO analysis?
faq.answer: Yes. It checks missing Q&A, definitions, comparisons, and formats that can affect AI answer visibility.

faq.question: Where are results saved?
faq.answer: The skill recommends saving research briefs under memory/research/content-gap-analysis with dated topic filenames.
